mainEntity.name: Which is the most intelligent AI model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Claude Opus 5 (Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort) currently leads the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 61, out of 173 models evaluated.

mainEntity.name: What are the top AI models?

acceptedAnswer.text: The top AI models by Intelligence Index are: 1. Claude Opus 5 (Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort) (61), 2. Claude Opus 5 (Adaptive Reasoning, Xhigh Effort) (60), 3. Claude Fable 5 (Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort, Opus 4.8 Fallback) (60), 4. GPT-5.6 Sol (max) (59), and 5. Claude Opus 5 (Adaptive Reasoning, High Effort) (59).

mainEntity.name: Which is the fastest AI model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mercury 2 is the fastest at 850.9 tokens per second, followed by LFM2.5-VL-1.6B (395.4 t/s) and Step 3.7 Flash (389.0 t/s).

mainEntity.name: Which is the cheapest AI model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nova Micro is the most affordable at $0.03 per 1M tokens (blended), followed by Sarvam 30B (high) ($0.03) and Gemma 4 E4B (Non-reasoning) ($0.03).

mainEntity.name: Which AI model has the lowest latency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (Non-reasoning) has the lowest time to first token at 0.38s, followed by Command A+ (0.39s) and Grok Build 0.1 0616 (0.53s).

mainEntity.name: Which is the best open weights AI model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kimi K3 (max) is the highest-ranked open weights model with an Intelligence Index score of 57. There are 97 open weights models out of 173 total evaluated.

mainEntity.name: What are the top open weights AI models?

acceptedAnswer.text: The top open weights AI models by Intelligence Index are: 1. Kimi K3 (max) (57), 2. GLM-5.2 (max) (51), and 3. Kimi K3 (low) (47).

mainEntity.name: Which is the best reasoning model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Claude Opus 5 (Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort) leads among 129 reasoning models with an Intelligence Index score of 61. Reasoning models use extended thinking to work through complex problems before providing answers.

mainEntity.name: How are AI models compared on Artificial Analysis?

acceptedAnswer.text: Models are compared across multiple dimensions including intelligence (quality), pricing, output speed (tokens per second), latency (time to first token), end-to-end response time, and context window size. Performance metrics are measured directly using standardized prompts across 589 models.

mainEntity.name: How do I compare a specific model against others?

acceptedAnswer.text: Click on any model name or row in the charts to view its dedicated page with detailed metrics and direct comparisons against similar models. You can also use the model selector to customize which models appear in each chart.
